name: ZenFone 5

images.credit: Nandhinikandhasamy, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.Technology: GSM, HSPA (A500CG / A502CG), GSM, HSPA, LTE (A500KL)
Network.SIM: Dual SIM (Micro-SIM, dual stand-by), (A500KL is also available in Single Micro-SIM)

Platform.Operating system: A500CG: Android 4.3 (Jelly Bean), upgradable to 5.0.2 (Lollipop), A500KL: Android 4.4.2 (KitKat), upgradable to 5.0.2 (Lollipop), A502CG: Android 4.4.2 (KitKat)
Platform.Chipset: A500CG: Intel Atom Z2580, A500KL: Qualcomm MSM8926 Snapdragon 400, A502CG: Intel Atom Z2520
Platform.CPU: A500CG: Dual-core 2.0 GHz, A500KL: Quad-core 1.2 GHz Cortex-A7, A502CG: Dual-core 1.2 GHz
Platform.GPU: A500CG / A502CG: PowerVR SGX544MP2, A500KL: Adreno 305

Memory.RAM: A500CG: 2 GB RAM, A500KL: 1 GB / 2 GB RAM, A502CG: 1 GB RAM
Memory.Storage: A500CG / A500KL: 8 GB / 16 GB / 32 GB eMMC 4.5, A502CG: 8 GB eMMC 4.5

Display.Display: A500CG / A500KL: 5.0 in (127 mm) IPS LCD, 720 x 1280 pixels, 16:9 ratio (~294 ppi density), Corning Gorilla Glass 3, A502CG: 5.0 in (127 mm) IPS LCD, 540 x 960 pixels, 16:9 ratio (~220 ppi density), Oleophobic coating

Cameras.Rear camera: A500CG / A500KL: 8 MP, f/2.0, AF, LED flash, panorama (1080p@30fps video), A502CG: 8 MP, AF, LED flash, panorama (720p@30fps video)
Cameras.Front camera: A500CG / A500KL: 2 MP, f/2.4, A502CG: VGA

Battery.Battery: A500CG / A500KL: Non-removable Li-Po 2110 mAh, A502CG: Non-removable Li-Po 2500 mAh
